First, note the given date is 01-19-1469 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
Subtract 84 days from January 19, 1469.  

January has 31 days.  
84 days before Jan 19:  
Step 1: Go back 19 days → 1469-01-01.  
Remaining days to subtract: 84 - 19 = 65 days.  

Step 2: Move into December 1468. December has 31 days → 1468-12-01 after subtracting 31 days from Jan 1. Remaining: 65 - 31 = 34 days.  

Step 3: November 1468 has 30 days → 1468-11-01 after subtracting 30 days from Dec 1. Remaining: 34 - 30 = 4 days.  

Step 4: Subtract 4 more days from Nov 1 → 1468-10-28.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1468-10-28
